steps.title: Define Application Metadata
steps.description: Establish the application name 'Nexus Elite' and setup the package name 'com.nexuselite.app' in the configuration metadata.

steps.title: Configure Build Settings
steps.description: Write build.gradle with correct SDK compliance, Target 34, Min SDK 21, and exact AGP configuration.

steps.title: Declare App Manifest
steps.description: Establish the AndroidManifest.xml referencing the launcher icon, setting up MainActivity, and declaring the proper layout scheme and namespace.

steps.title: Resolve Launcher Asset Conflicts
steps.description: Ensure the system-provided 'icon.png' is used as the sole launcher asset, preventing resource merger collisions from legacy vector files.

steps.title: Generate Custom Styled Drawables
steps.description: Produce gorgeous background shape drawables for splash backgrounds, card components, buttons, active tabs, and navigation components.

steps.title: Establish Base Colors and Typography
steps.description: Configure light and dark color schemes, modern style constants, and text strings inside values folder.

steps.title: Design the Responsive Layout XML
steps.description: Structure the splash loader overlay, welcome headings, profile management system, in-app notifications hub, and bottom tab bar interfaces in activity_main.xml.

steps.title: Implement Synthesizer Sound System
steps.description: Develop low-latency programmatic audio track wave synthesizers for button clicks and the splash screen entry sound, storing preferences in SharedPreferences.

steps.title: Develop Page View Controller and Tabs
steps.description: Implement interactive page management, bottom navigation actions, active indicators, and real-time animation transitions.

steps.title: Integrate Favorites and History Trackers
steps.description: Build high-speed persistent caching using SharedPreferences to remember user's active favorites, recently viewed features, and interactions.

steps.title: Establish Dynamic Theme Engine
steps.description: Create runtime system to smoothly swap application-wide themes between dark/light and update visual styles across layout matrices without app reload.

steps.title: Integrate Profile and In-App Notifications
steps.description: Implement editable user credentials form, profile card layouts, active notifications lists, and badges.

steps.title: Perform Strict Verification and Polish
steps.description: Audit all source code for absolute Java 8 compatibility, remove lambdas, ensure complete namespace configuration, and check memory safety.

steps.title: Building Nexus Elite
steps.description: Assemble and compile debug targets to build the high-performance application.
